_doc: Hand-kept rules for tools/world/zone_tags.py, which writes data/world/zone_tags.json: a ground type for every floor texture, and a biome for every room. Ground effects (grass, pebbles, other plants) are meant to key on the ground type, ambient effects (bats, motes, leaves) on the biome (docs/adr/0003 "Ground types and biomes"). Fix a wrong label in "ground_overrides" (texture -> type) or "biome_overrides" (room id -> biome), never in the generated file.

ground_types._doc: Floor texture name (build/textures/catalog.json) -> ground type: the first pattern that matches (case-insensitive). Up-facing surfaces that aren't ground get roof, ceiling, furniture (tabletops, counters, steps, fountain tops), wall or crops, so ground effects never land on them; "floor" is an indoor floor the name doesn't say more about. Unmatched surfaces are "other".

biomes._doc: A room's biome, from the original's terrain flags (Kod viTerrain_type, TERRAIN_* without the prefix, lower case), its kind (outdoor / interior / underground: tools/world/zone_configs.py) and its region (data/world/regions.json): the first rule all of whose conditions hold. terrain_any: one of these flags; kind: one of these kinds; region_any: the region contains one of these words.
